title: resourceContext
responsibility: Builds a lease environment with bounded CPU, RAM and native threads, and records child process identity.

inputs.name: resourceContext.id
inputs.description: Lease UUID whose job or heartbeat is read or updated.

inputs.name: resourceContext.request
inputs.description: Requested priority, CPU cores, memory in MiB and public label to validate against available capacity.

inputs.name: resourceContext.env
inputs.description: Resource and caller environment used to resolve paths or bounded worker settings; unrelated credentials are not newly propagated.

inputs.name: resourceContext.queue
inputs.description: Shared queue used to track child PID and process start identity under this lease.

outputs.name: resourceContext
outputs.description: Lease environment with bounded native threads and a callback recording child identity.
